title: Ansible testnet benchmark rerun

attempts.name: 268a-old-writers-invalid
attempts.reason: Clean reset invalidated reused writer manifest from item 261. All endpoints failed before load when kombat_getPolicy returned no result.

attempts.name: 268b-fresh-writers-four-loadgen-hosts
attempts.command: LOADTEST_EXTERNAL_RUNNER_HOSTS='root@203.0.113.10 root@203.0.113.12 root@203.0.113.18 root@203.0.113.11' LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-268b-ansible-testnet-fresh-writers-100k-60s LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=4 LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0 LOADTEST_FAIL_ON_ERRORS=1 bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 100000 60
attempts.reason: External loadgen host root@203.0.113.18 closed the SSH session for validator-1:8646 during load. This is a loadgen transport failure, not a chain throughput result.

attempts.name: 268c-three-loadgen-hosts
attempts.command: LOADTEST_EXTERNAL_RUNNER_HOSTS='root@203.0.113.10 root@203.0.113.12 root@203.0.113.11' LOADTEST_WRITERS_JSON=/tmp/and-live-268b-ansible-testnet-fresh-writers-100k-60s/writers-all.json LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-268c-ansible-testnet-three-loadgen-hosts-100k-60s LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=4 LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0 LOADTEST_FAIL_ON_ERRORS=1 bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 100000 60
attempts.reason: Excluding the flaky loadgen host avoided SSH failure but under-drove the network and did not converge: v1-v3 stayed at height 260 with head 0xa780f6a81a988f3b93fe79287643b61af95cf14641051d0f2d75b72c2c818a7f while v4 stayed at height 258 with head 0xbd90dbb48e2caef11485a2d074a454cfa81b3348341b8e6f975da913d585db91 after settle.

conclusion: More loadgen hosts did not make the chain path worse. The four-host run failed because one loadgen host dropped SSH mid-load. The three-host rerun was under-driven and produced a non-converged head, so it is binned. The next benchmark should use four reliable loadgen hosts or run loadgen processes under persistent systemd units/tmux instead of transient SSH sessions.
